set -exo pipefail
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates python3
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone from trusted hardcoded source (ignore webhook payload),
# matching the other CI templates' security posture.
git clone --branch main "https://github.com/jedarden/SEAM.git" /workspace
cd /workspace
echo "Commit: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
go version

echo "=== gofmt ==="
UNFORMATTED="$(gofmt -l .)"
if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
  echo "gofmt would reformat the following files:"
  echo "$UNFORMATTED"
  exit 1
fi

echo "=== go vet ==="
go vet ./...

echo "=== golangci-lint ==="
# Installed via the Go module proxy, NOT upstream's install.sh.
#
# install.sh was fetched unpinned from master (a :latest-class
# hazard: upstream can change it under us at any time) and then
# downloaded a GitHub release tarball that this cluster's egress
# corrupts deterministically -- two runs produced the identical
# wrong sha256 fd3a137c... against the genuine 8df580d2..., so
# the installer aborted and the gate never ran. Because the
# corruption is reproducible rather than flaky, a retry loop
# does not fix it; the download path itself has to go.
#
# `go install` uses the same module proxy that `go mod download`
# already succeeds with in this very step, and verifies against
# GOSUMDB, so it is both reachable and checksum-pinned.
go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.12.2
# Report every finding. Default caps (max-issues-per-linter=50,
# max-same-issues=3) silently truncate repeated findings, which
# makes the printed count read as the total when it is not.
"$(go env GOPATH)/bin/golangci-lint" run \
  --max-issues-per-linter=0 --max-same-issues=0 ./...

echo "=== go test -race ==="
go test -race ./...

echo "=== benchmark gate (plan.md -> Performance Budgets -> CI-gated benchmarks) ==="
go test -bench=. -benchmem -run=^$ ./... | tee /tmp/bench-new.txt

if [ -f bench/baseline.txt ]; then
  # x/perf carries no tagged releases — pin by commit for reproducibility.
  go install golang.org/x/perf/cmd/benchstat@9e4b9ddef5b6a4371594ec978cb4b8088bec845d
  benchstat bench/baseline.txt /tmp/bench-new.txt | tee /tmp/benchstat.txt
  python3 -c "
import re, sys
worst = 0.0
for line in open('/tmp/benchstat.txt'):
    m = re.search(r'([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%', line)
    if m:
        worst = max(worst, float(m.group(1)))
print(f'Worst regression: {worst:.1f}%')
sys.exit(1 if worst > 20.0 else 0)
"
else
  echo "No committed bench/baseline.txt yet - benchmark gate is inert until Phase 2 establishes one (plan.md CI-gated benchmarks)."
fi

echo "CI passed!"

set -exo pipefail
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates jq
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

VERSION="{{inputs.parameters.version}}"
COMMIT="{{inputs.parameters.commit}}"
DIGEST="{{inputs.parameters.digest}}"
API="https://api.github.com/repos/jedarden/SEAM"

git clone --branch main "https://github.com/jedarden/SEAM.git" /workspace
cd /workspace
git checkout -q "$COMMIT"

ASSET="seam_${VERSION}_linux_amd64"
CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 \
  go build -trimpath -ldflags '-s -w' -o "$ASSET" ./cmd/seam

# Smoke the artifact we are about to publish: healthcheck against a
# port nothing is serving must fail, which proves the binary runs
# and its subcommand dispatch works.
if "./$ASSET" healthcheck --caller-port 1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: healthcheck unexpectedly succeeded against a dead port" >&2
  exit 1
fi

RESP="$(curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" "$API/releases/tags/v${VERSION}" || echo '')"
if [ -n "$RESP" ]; then
  RELEASE_ID="$(echo "$RESP" | jq -r '.id')"
  if [ "$(echo "$RESP" | jq -r '.draft')" = "false" ]; then
    echo "v${VERSION} already published - skipping"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "v${VERSION} exists as a draft - publishing it in place"
else
  # GHCR packages default to PRIVATE even when the source repo is
  # public, and GitHub exposes no REST endpoint to change that -- it
  # is a one-time per-package UI setting. So probe anonymously and
  # let the notes state what is actually true rather than assume it.
  # v0.1.0 shipped claiming "(public)" while the package was private.
  ANON="$(curl -fsSL "https://ghcr.io/token?scope=repository:jedarden/seam:pull&service=ghcr.io" | jq -r '.token // empty')"
  PULL_CODE="$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%%{http_code}' \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ANON" \
    -H 'Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json' \
    "https://ghcr.io/v2/jedarden/seam/manifests/${VERSION}")"
  if [ "$PULL_CODE" = "200" ]; then
    VISIBILITY="The GHCR package is public - docker pull needs no authentication."
  else
    VISIBILITY="NOTE: the GHCR package is currently PRIVATE (anonymous pull returned HTTP ${PULL_CODE}), so docker pull requires authentication. Flip it once at https://github.com/users/jedarden/packages/container/seam/settings"
    echo "WARNING: ghcr.io/jedarden/seam:${VERSION} is not anonymously pullable (HTTP ${PULL_CODE})" >&2
  fi

  NOTES="Built from commit ${COMMIT}.

Container image:
  ghcr.io/jedarden/seam:${VERSION}
  ghcr.io/jedarden/seam@${DIGEST}

Pin the digest, not the tag, in declarative-config -- plan.md defines
rollback as reverting the image-digest commit.

${VISIBILITY}"
  CREATED="$(jq -n \
    --arg tag "v${VERSION}" \
    --arg name "SEAM v${VERSION}" \
    --arg body "$NOTES" \
    '{tag_name:$tag, name:$name, body:$body, draft:true, prerelease:false, target_commitish:"main"}' \
    | curl -fsSL -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data @- "$API/releases")"
  RELEASE_ID="$(echo "$CREATED" | jq -r '.id')"
fi

# Replace any same-named asset so a retry does not append a duplicate.
EXISTING="$(curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
  "$API/releases/${RELEASE_ID}/assets" | jq -r --arg n "$ASSET" '.[] | select(.name==$n) | .id')"
for a in $EXISTING; do
  curl -fsSL -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" "$API/releases/assets/${a}"
done

curl -fsSL -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \
  --data-binary "@${ASSET}" \
  "https://uploads.github.com/repos/jedarden/SEAM/releases/${RELEASE_ID}/assets?name=${ASSET}"

# Publish last, so a release is never visible without its binary.
curl -fsSL -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"draft":false}' "$API/releases/${RELEASE_ID}"

FINAL="$(curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" "$API/releases/tags/v${VERSION}" | jq -r '.draft')"
if [ "$FINAL" != "false" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: v${VERSION} did not publish (draft=${FINAL})" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Published v${VERSION} with ${ASSET} and ghcr.io/jedarden/seam@${DIGEST}"

set -exo pipefail
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates jq
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

git clone --branch main --depth 50 "https://github.com/jedarden/SEAM.git" /workspace
cd /workspace
git rev-parse HEAD > /tmp/commit

test -f containers/seam/VERSION || {
  echo "containers/seam/VERSION is required; CI never invents a version" >&2
  exit 1
}
VERSION="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < containers/seam/VERSION)"

# Semver only. This is also what keeps the image tag off :latest --
# the fleet's standing ban -- since the tag is this value verbatim.
case "$VERSION" in
  [0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*) ;;
  *) echo "VERSION must be a semantic version, got: $VERSION" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
printf '%s' "$VERSION" > /tmp/version

# Skip only when the tag is genuinely PUBLISHED. A draft is treated
# as releasable so the release step can publish it in place --
# jedarden/bead-rs saw GitHub silently revert v0.1.0 to draft twice,
# and needle-workflowtemplate.yml carries the same defense.
RESP="$(curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/jedarden/SEAM/releases/tags/v${VERSION}" || echo '')"
if [ -n "$RESP" ] && [ "$(echo "$RESP" | jq -r '.draft')" = "false" ]; then
  echo "v${VERSION} is already published - nothing to release"
  printf 'false' > /tmp/should-release
else
  echo "v${VERSION} is not published yet - releasing"
  printf 'true' > /tmp/should-release
fi
